+    def _is_all_or_any_with_iterable(self, node):
+        """Check if node is all() or any() call with a generator/list comprehension."""
+        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
+            return None
+        if not isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
+            return None
+        if node.func.id not in ("all", "any"):
+            return None
+        if len(node.args) != 1:
+            return None
+        arg = node.args[0]
+        if isinstance(arg, (ast.GeneratorExp, ast.ListComp)):
+            return node.func.id, arg
+        return None
+
+    def _unroll_all_or_any(self, all_or_any_id, iterable_node, assert_):
+        """Unroll all() or any() calls into for loops with individual assertions."""
+        # For now, we only handle single-level comprehensions
+        if len(iterable_node.generators) != 1:
+            return None
+        
+        comp = iterable_node.generators[0]
+        
+        # We don't handle comprehensions with conditions yet
+        if comp.ifs:
+            return None
+        
+        # Create a new assert statement for the element
+        element_assert = ast.Assert(iterable_node.elt, assert_.msg)
+        
+        # Create a for loop
+        for_loop = ast.For(
+            target=comp.target,
+            iter=comp.iter,
+            body=[element_assert],
+            orelse=[]
+        )
+        
+        # Copy location info
+        set_location(for_loop, assert_.lineno, assert_.col_offset)
+        set_location(element_assert, assert_.lineno, assert_.col_offset)
+        
+        return [for_loop]
+
